name: Create a Google Calendar Event
description: Create an event on Google Calendar with support for attendees, location, description, reminders, and all-day events.

startDateTime.description: Start time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-03-15T10:00:00-07:00') or date for all-day events ('2024-03-15')

endDateTime.description: End time in ISO 8601 format or date for all-day events

timeZone.description: Time zone (e.g., 'America/Los_Angeles'). Defaults to calendar's time zone.

steps.name: Create event via Google Calendar API
